functions.name: Reset
functions.docs:
Reset the timestep to a default state. Called on restarting a simulation.
Note we will not update till after an evolution so GetDt must succeed beore
we call the first Update

functions.name: GetActualDt
functions.docs:
Get how much time actually passed (Dt and any sleeps) mainly for stats.
By default will just return Dt

functions.name: SetTarget
functions.docs: Called to set a target dt if necessary - derived timesteps can ignore if not needed

functions.name: GetTarget
functions.docs: Called to retrieve the target time for the timestep. By default returns whatever the Dt was intended to be
